/*getCommonNoNeMyMenuAllList*/ SELECT (LEVEL - 1) LVL , X.MENUID AS MENU_ID , X.UPPERID AS UPPER_ID , X.NAME , LTRIM(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(X.NAME, ' ＞ '), ' ＞') PATH , CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF IS_LEAF , X.MY_MENU_YN , X.URL , X.TYPE , X.MENUORDER AS MENU_ORDER , X.TOPMENUID FROM ( SELECT MENU.MENU_ID AS MENUID , MENU.UPPER_ID AS UPPERID , MENU.NAME , MENU.DEPTH , MENU.TYPE , AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID , MENU.URL , MENU.MENU_ORDER AS MENUORDER , MENU.MENU_DC AS MENUDC , MENU.CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT , DECODE(SUBSTR(MENU.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(MENU.DEPTH, 0,MENU.MENU_ID, 1,MENU.MENU_ID, 2,MENU.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = MENU.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID , NVL(MENU.ROLE_ID,'N') AS ROLEID , DECODE(PRTY.PRTY_VALUE, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS MY_MENU_YN FROM KX_MENUINFO MENU , KX_MENUAUTH AUTH , ( SELECT PRTY.* FROM KX_USERPRTY PRTY WHERE PRTY.PRTY_KEY = 'MYMENU_LIST' AND PRTY.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND PRTY.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) PRTY WHERE MENU.MENU_ID = AUTH.MENU_ID AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND NVL(AUTH.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND ( MENU.ROLE_ID IN ( SELECT ROLE_ID FROM KX_USERROLE WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) OR MENU.ROLE_ID IS NULL ) AND AUTH.AUTH_ID IN (SELECT AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTH_ID --사용자의 ROLE FROM KX_AUTHINFO AUTH , KX_USERAUTH USERAUTH WHERE AUTH.AUTH_ID = USERAUTH.AUTH_ID AND USERAUTH.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND AUTH.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND USERAUTH.USE_FLAG = 'Y') AND MENU.MENU_ID = PRTY.PRTY_VALUE(+) AND MENU.TYPE != 'tab' ORDER BY MENU.DEPTH ASC , MENU.MENU_ORDER ASC ) X
START WITH X.DEPTH = 2 AND X.MENUID LIKE 'sr%' --협력사
START WITH X.DEPTH = 2 AND X.MENUID LIKE 'br%' --고객사
CONNECT BY PRIOR X.MENUID = X.UPPERID
ORDER SIBLINGS BY X.MENUID

/*getCommonNoNeMyMenuList*/ SELECT A.USER_ID , A.PRTY_KEY , A.PRTY_SEQ , A.PRTY_VALUE , C.MENU_ID , C.UPPER_ID , C.NAME , C.URL , DECODE(SUBSTR(C.MENU_ID, 0, 1), 'b', 'b00100000000', DECODE(C.DEPTH, 0,C.MENU_ID, 1,C.MENU_ID, 2,C.UPPER_ID, 3,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = C.UPPER_ID), 4,(SELECT UPPER_ID FROM KX_MENUINFO WHERE MENU_ID = C.UPPER_ID) )) AS TOPMENUID FROM KX_USERPRTY A , KX_MENUAUTH B , KX_MENUINFO C WHERE A.PRTY_KEY = 'MYMENU_LIST' AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.PRTY_VALUE = B.MENU_ID AND B.MENU_ID = C.MENU_ID AND A.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND ( C.ROLE_ID IN ( SELECT ROLE_ID FROM KX_USERROLE WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) OR C.ROLE_ID IS NULL ) AND B.AUTH_ID = ( SELECT AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTH_ID --사용자의 ROLE FROM KX_AUTHINFO AUTH , KX_USERAUTH USERAUTH WHERE AUTH.AUTH_ID = USERAUTH.AUTH_ID AND USERAUTH.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND AUTH.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND USERAUTH.USE_FLAG = 'Y')
AND C.MENU_ID LIKE 'sr%'
AND C.MENU_ID LIKE 'br%'
ORDER BY A.PRTY_SEQ
